summary: The Backrooms is a persistent survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and scenes provide local environments, while shared systems own combat, NPCs, loot, building, and avatar rendering. `scripts/lib/critter-model.js` supports the global human/furry body switch: human GLB bodies carry individual morphable heads with sex-specific fitted hair, while furry bodies retain species heads and hair.
places: places/bonus (3D) - shared vaporwave mall with authored shops and landmarks, simulated staff, shoppers, and balcony loungers.
places/main (3D) - authored Level 0/Lobby maze; sim generates furniture and loot, safe-room almond water, shifting walls, creature ecology, and route-guidance moments.
places/intake (3D) + places/tutorial0 (solo ephemeral 3D) - bedroom character-creation/waking space and authored tutorial route with staged encounter and HALOGEN.

places/level1, places/level2, places/level21 (3D) - Habitable Zone, Pipe Dreams, and Locked; Level 2 uses Tripo room/hall props over its collider shell; Level 2.1 has Base Alef and the locker/restroom/back-hall cluster opening toward The Edges caves.
places/level3, places/gamma, places/level4, places/level5 (3D) - Electrical Station, Base Gamma, Abandoned Office, and Terror Hotel; residents, hazards, office/home systems, and Boiler Room rats.
places/level6, places/level7, places/level10, places/level11 (3D) - later authored/generated levels including city, farm, and venues; Level 10's poster routes to Level 26.
places/level26 (3D) - SS Fun =) Adventure liner in green fog with authored ship, decks, wrecked venues, Partygoers, and Phoebe; lower decks reach y=-80 within worldBounds bottom=-110.

places/debug (3D) - x1z0 includes a 12-mannequin animation gallery using current human bodies and a HUMAN/FURRY switch pad; places/spamton and other configured places are auxiliary/fight spaces or continuing Backrooms routes.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, player/camera setup, and ordered behavior composition; L maps to kick and Z to grab.

places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - place settings, authored placements, and local generated/ticked behavior; places/main/sim.js owns Level 0 generation and timers; root sim.js applies body-style changes to occupied places.
scripts/main-menu.js + scripts/main-menu-ui.js - title/pause, character creation, arrival, tutorial routing, first-arrival Level 26 cutscene driver, and BODIES toggle.
places/intake/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/intake-geo.js + scripts/lib/intro-cut.js - bedroom shell and waking sequence; tutorial scene and tut0 geometry/sim scripts own its route and beats.

scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - camera and third-person toggle; camera handles collision-constrained shoulder-height orbit including low-ceiling backoff; scripts/ui.js and specialized UI scripts present HUD, panels, and cutscenes.
places/debug/cells/x1z0.scene + scripts/dbg-pose.js + scripts/dbg-bodypad.js - clip gallery mannequins and in-world body-style switch.
art/l26-ship/{build,hull,super,lib,tex}.py and art/level2/{build,compact,encode,pack}.py - offline Blender/packing sources for ship and Level 2 kit assets.

art/human-base/build.py + art/human-head/headtypes.py + art/tripo-hair/fit.py + art/human-hair/build.py + art/nv-melee/retarget.py + art/fp-arm/{build,kfhand}.py - human T-pose bodies/head-type keys, fitted hair, retargeted melee clips, and separate first-person arms.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js - shared/solo room IDs, Bonus Room and home destinations/crossings; used by routing and hub handlers and defines last-level selection/names.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/weapons.yml - common loot spawning, container rolls, remains, place pools, and weapon definitions/rarity reused by search and combat.
scripts/lib/build-piece.js + breakables.yml + furniture.yml - canonical build specs/models shared by B-mode and home reconstruction; CRT TV builds attach scripts/built-tv.js.
scripts/lib/screen.js - derived read-only panel classifier and wrist gates shared by player, stats, craft, rest, and menu input.
scripts/lib/maze.js and scripts/lib/level*.js + level data - grids, zones, layouts, and paths reused by place sims, geometry, and navigation.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + clothes.yml + critter.yml + hair.yml + scripts/lib/critter-model.js - shared player/NPC wardrobe and avatar construction; human bodies use own head morphs and sex-specific Tripo hair, furry bodies retain species heads and hat-aware hair.

scripts/lib/body3.js + scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml - third-person human/furry weapon stance, retargeted melee/fire/reaction/reload clips, long-gun hand IK, and timing; used by player.js, critter.js, and meg-agent.js.

scripts/lib/l2kit.js + scripts/lib/l2props.js and data - Level 2 kit decoding and metre-fitted Tripo props reused by Level 2/2.1; scripts/lib/loose.js + loose.yml serve shared kick/grab/flight/breakable prop effects.
notableExports: scripts/lib/loot.js - POOL, poolOf, rollWeapon, gateItems, rollLock, rollCash, rollItem, spawnCrate and Level 2 container/loot helpers; scripts/lib/weapons.js - rarityIdx, rarityCap and weapon registry.
scripts/lib/l2props.js - PROPS, fitBox, spawnProp, dressRoom, dressHall, containerModel, crateModel.
scripts/grab.js - setDown, onInput, update, looseSpent; carrying, throwing, and scheduled extinguisher-jet expiry. scripts/kick.js - onInput, kickEnd, update.
scripts/player.js - maxHp, maxSan, xpNeed, weaponOf, gain, takeToken, useSnack, onInput, hitTarget, and fishing handlers.
scripts/lib/screen.js - WRIST, screen, canOpen, openWrist; scripts/routing.js - pickRoom.
sim.js - cadence, tick, onOutOfBounds; places/main/sim.js and places/bonus/sim.js - cadence, tick.

scripts/critter.js - update; scripts/lib/critter-model.js - skinOf, humanBody, humanMorph, bodyModel, critterSpec, restyle/restylePlace, humanHairOf/seatHumanHair, furrySpec and appearance helpers; Phoebe uses furrySpec.
scripts/lib/body3.js - heldRot, famOf, play, tick3, swing3, fire3, handle3, react3, aimPose, aimMode, longHands, stance; scripts/lib/vmpose.js - VM_FOV, poseViewmodel.
ownership: scripts/player.js - persistent player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment/ammo, needs, money, appearance, combat/rewards, and level access; saved place/position and one-shot wakeAtSave restoration; reload timing in reload state.
scripts/kick.js + scripts/grab.js - per-player kick rolls/cooldowns, carried prop/body IDs, held-body grip, and throw/carry session fields; target body state.heldBy/down controls hold and release.
scripts/lib/loose.js - arms matched props with state.loose/mat/hp/maxHp and owns broke/act effects; per-player session.loose tracks kicked/thrown item flights until impact.
scripts/lib/knock.js - shared physics/timing recovery for down/kb and thrown/overboard records; enemy managers retain AI state and pause it while held or recovering.
scripts/lurkers.js - player.state.lurkHold while caught and lurker entity grab/frenzy/prey state; release clears the player's hold.
scripts/build.js - active B-mode selection/ghost/session and placed build pieces; homeKeep.built persists home builds reconstructed by home sim.
scripts/hub.js - mall offer/shop/food and room-hop flags plus player trainHid/stungUntil; session.ride/rideTrain holds transient transit scene and spawned train.

places/level2/sim.js owns place.state seeded/kitV/rev/sludgeV/propsV and room layout; places/level21/sim.js owns generated geometry/dressing revision and seeded local environment; scripts/critter-model.js owns avatar model/head/hair construction, with world.state.bodyStyle selecting human or furry.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered behaviors: locomotion/player, swim, interact/grab/kick/rest/mahjong/talk/build/noclip/stats/craft/OS/lockpick/spamton-fight/horde/critter/main-menu/hub/view3.
world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → third-person camera; camera writes player.state.aimPt → player.js crosshair-aligned shots.
scripts/routing.js accepts permitted requested rooms; otherwise scripts/lib/hub.js soloRoom selects player's solo Backrooms room and bonus overflow IDs.
Fresh visit → scripts/main-menu.js; START enters intake for creation or bonus for completed characters; wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 unless t0Done.

scripts/main-menu.js BODIES action or debug pad → world.state.bodyStyle (menu also persists player.state.bodyStyle); root sim.js/critter.js set critter-model style and restyle people in occupied places; new critter/critter-model spawns use selected style.
scripts/lib/hub.js toHub/toSolo → room/place crossings; roomHop distinguishes intentional crossings from launch/resume.
Death recovery → scripts/hub.js hubOffer → hub-ui.js; mall counters write hubShop → hub handler/UI; purchases debit cents and grant configured stock.

Teleport Station UI in scripts/hub-ui.js renders lastLevel(s) from scripts/lib/hub.js; travel requests reach scripts/hub.js, which boards the player via bc-train, animates a session train, and crosses to the destination.
Found loot search → scripts/interact.js calls loot.gateItems for non-storage/non-NPC contents; rarity caps are level 1-2 common, 3-5 uncommon, 6-9 rare, 10+ elite; pickups enter player.js inventory.

L input → scripts/kick.js tries foe kick then loose.js kickLoose; Z input → scripts/grab.js picks/carries/throws eligible bodies, plays the UAL overhand throw clip, and calls loose.js arm/track/impact; flight tracking detects hard stops.

Player attack → scripts/player.js calls body3.swing3/fire3 for third-person body animations; scripts/critter.js merges aim/ready pose and longHands IK; first-person viewmodel uses vmpose.js and weapon-look.js, with player.js composing its viewmodel.

Human body IDs and head morph keys in critter-models.yml → critter-model.js chooses own head form and hair.yml's sex/hat-specific hair; critter.js updates/restyles player and place bodies, while humanoid-locomotion.js supplies human gait/idles. Level 2.1 place sim reads level21.js/data and spawns scripts/level21-geo.js; revisioned sim build supplies its geometry, lights, props, and residents.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus/cells/x0z0.scene + scripts/lib/data/bonus.yml + places/bonus/sim.js + scripts/mall-shopper.js - authored mall shops/landmarks with data-driven stock and simulated staff, waypoint shoppers, and balcony loungers.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + scripts/lib/build-piece.js + scripts/build.js + places/home11/sim.js - per-piece models/dimensions with common placement, persistence, and rebuild path; CRT TV builds add matching screen, sound, and glow.
places/main/cells/* and places/level5/cells/* - authored fixtures with local sound/light and zone variants; Level 5 includes portal/quest props and Boiler Room Death Rat packs.
places/level4/cells/x0z0.scene + Level 4 geometry/detail/prop/look and l4-office.js/l4-office-geo.js/l4-home.js - office layout and fixtures with resident schedules/home claims.
scripts/lib/l4-people.js + level4-people.yml and scripts/lib/l5-people.js + level5-people.yml - per-NPC role/dialogue/look/routine on shared meg-agent behavior.

scripts/lib/clothes.js + scripts/lib/critter-model.js + critter.yml/hair.yml/critter-models.yml - deterministic player/NPC looks and style selection; human heads have stable seeded face/head-type morphs and fitted hair, furry looks use species heads, clothes and hats vary by look.

scripts/lib/data/combat-anims.yml + scripts/lib/body3.js - clip rows by melee/gun/common family reused by player bodies and M.E.G. agents; third-person long-gun attachment and aim differ from first-person posing.

scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js + scripts/critter.js - human gait/weapon pose integration; NPC human idles are selected per person, avoid fold-arm clips that intersect the torso, and add head tracking and periodic fidgets.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - exports procedural balloon geometry/skeleton/collider but Level 26 scene placements and barrage use uploaded models instead.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - header marks it as a temporary hair lane test rig; no tree/package references found.
migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Keep routing and hub identity aligned.

Teleport Station 'last' travel derives from savePlace (excluding bonus, intake, and debug; tutorial0 maps to main); keepPos preserves savePos and wakeAtSave restores it only when the arriving place matches; transit depends on bc-train asset.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; existing weapon ownership/use and non-weapon loot are not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.
Level 0 place.state.momentsV is 4: migration deletes old tagged moment entities before relaying them; preserve deterministic route/arrow direction logic when changing moment layout.

Level 2 l2props.yml sizes are metres; fitBox places its mesh collider from floor y=0. Props spawn static because dynamic bodies created before floor mesh cooking fall through; Level 2.1 revisioned cleanup/rebuild must keep l2prop-generated dressing and geometry coordinated.

Human GLBs in critter-models.yml are T-pose rigs required by combat-anims.yml/body3.js and humanoid-locomotion.js; head type morph keys are authored in art/human-head/headtypes.py, hair.yml selects sex- and hat-fit skinned hair, and STYLE_V drives room-wide re-dress migrations.
